Messages.Author: Zacour James
Messages.Body:
How does taste of vitae work with additional strikes?

Can I play taste of vitae during the damage resolution phase after the
normal strike but before additional strikes?

If so,
If through additional strikes, my opponent manages to do enough damage to
send my vampire to torpor, do I still collect from taste of vitae? Do I
still go to torpor, or can I use the blood I collect from tate of vitae
to prevent going to torpor?

Also - do I collect blood from taste of vitae during the current damage
resolution phase or at the end of the round of combat?

Does taste of vitae give blood for blood lost after it is played during
the current round of combat?

Thanks

-James

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Zacour James <3j...@qlink.queensu.ca> wrote:
>How does taste of vitae work with additional strikes?
>Can I play taste of vitae during the damage resolution phase after the
>normal strike but before additional strikes?

You can play Taste of Vitae after the initial Check Damage step but before
additional strikes, yes.

>If through additional strikes, my opponent manages to do enough damage to
>send my vampire to torpor, do I still collect from taste of vitae? Do I
>still go to torpor, or can I use the blood I collect from tate of vitae
>to prevent going to torpor?

No. Taste of Vitae is not usable by a vampire going into torpor
(card text).

>Also - do I collect blood from taste of vitae during the current damage
>resolution phase or at the end of the round of combat?

You collect the blood as soon as it's played, which must be after the
initial Check Damage step.

>Does taste of vitae give blood for blood lost after it is played during
>the current round of combat?

No.
